core_summary: Matt tends to respond when music has body first and brain at the summit: pressure, hooks under strain, emotional conviction, album-world coherence, and production that reveals the artist's essence. Polish can work when it has blood, bite, architecture, or a hard persona center.
high_confidence_anchors: Radiohead: The Bends and OK Computer
Muse: Origin of Symmetry and Absolution
Taylor Swift hard persona-pop and pop architecture
dead_end_shortlist: broad emo from Jimmy Eat World
broad gothic metal from Type O Negative
tasteful prestige indie without blood or body
generic pop sheen without persona or architecture
guardrails: A mission is not a playlist.
Do not treat Waypoints as Landmarks.
Do not turn Type O Negative into broad gothic metal appetite.
Do not turn Muse into Tool, A Perfect Circle, or generic prog-metal seriousness.
Do not turn Taylor Swift into generic pop appetite.
Preserve uncertainty and design for evidence.
